description: The Google accounts this server reaches, per product. Start here: every other tool takes one of these labels. Under `gmail`: the mailboxes, which one a tool uses when no account is given, and which grant each runs on: `modify` (its own; the write tools work) or `readonly` (a read-only grant; the write tools refuse). Under `calendar`: the accounts whose calendars it reaches, the address each grant must resolve to, and the time zone. Under `drive`: which grant Drive runs on (its own once begin_consent made one, else an rclone remote's when one is configured). Under `editors`: the accounts Docs, Sheets and Slides can act as (one may run on the Drive grant; any other needs a grant made with begin_consent). Under `tasks`, `contacts` and `meet`: the accounts with a grant for Google Tasks, for contacts and the directory, and for Meet's records. Says nothing about whether a grant is alive; that is health, which costs a round trip to Google.
name: list_accounts
title: List accounts
